{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_orders.shape[0])

# Remove refunded orders (they are not real revenue)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders after removing refunded
qa_orders_after = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders after removing refunded:", qa_orders_after.shape[0])

# Confirm QA orders are still present
if qa_orders_after.shape[0] > 0:
    print("QA orders are still present. Removing them.")
    df = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
else:
    print("No QA orders found after removing refunded.")

# Recheck conversion rate and revenue after cleaning and removing QA
print("\nFinal dataset shape:", df.shape)

# Stratified conversion and revenue
conversion_by_strata = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
revenue_by_strata = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack()

print("\nConversion rate by channel and customer_segment (final):")
print(conversion_by_strata)

print("\nAverage revenue by channel and customer_segment (final):")
print(revenue_by_strata)"}
